subject: 奉仙观三清殿 · 五间悬山大殿
author: Windmemories
source_note: 2026实拍核定五间六前檐柱、单檐悬山，删除供具、牌匾和现代周边；保留石柱、屋脊和大斗拱。
prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: a single fine-line architectural illustration for the Chinese heritage collection 访古.
Image 1 is the STYLE MASTER, an existing Vairocana Buddha contour drawing. Match its elegant, delicate, slightly organic thin lines, restrained detail, generous blank areas, and consistent visual density. Image 2 (and subsequent photos if applicable) is SUBJECT GEOMETRY ONLY: draw the actual named monument in that reference, preserving its identifying silhouette, roof type, visible storey count, bay count, openings, and proportions.
Create a refined, sparse BLACK INK ON PURE WHITE line drawing. Use confident fine contours with a few finer internal structural lines. All surfaces remain WHITE; use outlines for doors and windows rather than dark fills. No solid shadows, no broad grey shading, no crosshatching, no pencil grain, no texture, no gradient. No color, no gold, no black background. The white will become transparent and the ink the relevant dynasty color in the website.
Show the complete monument, centered, approximately straight-on at facade level, with verticals vertical and minimal perspective. Use only a few short ground lines. Remove tourists, foliage, vehicles, wires, modern signage, fences obstructing the structure, neighboring distractions and sky. Preserve architectural ornament selectively, without filling every roof tile or brick. No invented features. No labels, letters, calligraphy, dimension lines, captions, watermark, frame or border.
Wide compositions: landscape 1536×1024, entire building occupies about 82% of canvas width, roof/apex and base uncut, balanced breathing room. Tall pagodas: portrait 1024×1536, entire pagoda occupies about 82% of height, centred with equal side margins, apex and base uncut.


SUBJECT-SPECIFIC INSTRUCTIONS:
Draw ONLY the actual Sanqing Hall 三清殿 of Fengxian Guan 奉仙观 in Jiyuan, surviving Jin dynasty 1184 building. Photo 2 is a complete near-frontal view of the correct hall. Preserve exactly FIVE frontal structural bays defined by SIX stone columns, central bay slightly broader, all one storey. A long broad SINGLE-EAVED suspended-gable roof (xuan-shan), with two large chiwen ridge-end ornaments and modest overhanging eaves, NOT a hip-and-gable roof, not double-eaved. Heavy widely spaced dougong bracket clusters stand over each column and between columns as visible. Doors are recessed behind the six columns; keep their simple panel outline, with no dense lattice pattern. Straighten camera tilt but retain the actual broad low proportions, stone round/uneven column profiles and substantial projecting eave. Remove all plants, incense burners, signs, steles, placards, fire hydrant, lettering, background buildings and all roof-tile repetitions. Broad roof surfaces remain entirely white, with only ridge and eave outlines. Center the whole hall and small stepped podium on landscape1536x1024, with generous white margin. Sparse organic fine contours consistent with the Buddha master; no fill or hatching.

historical_sources.title: 故宫博物院：河南巩义蔡庄三官庙大殿调查与研究
historical_sources.supports: 附表奉仙观三清殿1184，五间悬山，前五铺作单杪单昂。

site_recommendation.name: 济源奉仙观
site_recommendation.yearNote: 采用现存三清殿金代纪年，不沿用唐垂拱元年建观年代。
site_recommendation.place: 河南 · 济源 · 荆梁北街
site_recommendation.lede: 奉仙观三清殿把宽大的悬山屋面托在六根前檐石柱上。厚重斗拱与清楚的五间柱网，使这座金代殿宇的结构在正面便能读出。

facts.label: 纪年
facts.text: 三清殿建于金大定二十四年（1184），与奉仙观唐代创建的历史分别记录。

facts.label: 形制
facts.text: 面阔五间，进深七架椽，单檐悬山顶；正面柱网和粗壮铺作保存金代建筑特征。

facts.label: 布局
facts.text: 观内另存清代山门与明代玉皇殿；本图只表现现存金代三清殿。
